premises.scope_used: orthonormal r-dimensional projection of a cap-one product law has density <= exp(r/2)

new_claim.statement: For r>=3 original coordinates Y and independent remaining product coordinates X, if the physical X-Y cross block B has full column rank with singular values sigma_j, then arbitrary same-side quadratic leakage obeys ||p_Q||_infinity <= r*sqrt(e)/(r-2)*(prod sigma_j)^(-1/r), and p_Q is continuous C0.

explicit_family.matrix: A_m=[[(1/2)UU^T,U],[U^T,(1/2)I_3]] with U three disjoint flat unit block vectors

next_step: From s_3(A)>=1, either expose a quantitatively nontrivial three-original-coordinate cross bank and apply QFORM-FINITE-BANK-PLANCHEREL-v1, or turn failure of every such bank into a quantitative low-cross-rank/grouped-star or ridge geometry without local reciprocal loss.
